titleSq: Banesë në shitje në Fushë Kosovë
titleEn: Apartment for sale in Fushë Kosovë
descriptionSq:
Ofrohet per shitje banese me siperfaqe 86.67 m², me lokacion ne Rrugen Arberia, Fushe Kosove.
Ndertim nga Cima Construction.
Me orientim nga Perendimi, ka kete renditje te hapesirave te brendshme: qendrim ditor, kuzhine, 2 dhoma gjumi, nje banjo, nje depo dhe nje ballkon.

Kontrata behet tek noteri direkt me kompanine ndertuese.
Punimet perfundojne ne fund te vitit 2026.
Sistemi i ngrohjes eshte elektrik nen dysheme.
Banesa ndodhet ne nje zone te zhvilluar, afer sherbimeve publike dhe private.
descriptionEn:
An apartment of 86.67 m² is offered for sale, located on Rruga Arberia, Fushë Kosovë.
Built by Cima Construction.
Facing West, it has the following layout of interior spaces: living room, kitchen, 2 bedrooms, one bathroom, one storage room and one balcony.
It is located on the 4th floor.

The contract is signed at the notary directly with the construction company.
The works will be completed at the end of 2026.
The heating system is electric underfloor heating.
The apartment is located in a developed area, near public and private services.
